title: workload.json of the tool-using agent Track
description: The whole shape of a Workload declaration of the agentic Track. Requiredness is split (ADR 0002, clarification of 2026-11-04). The schema requires the keys every entry point reads. It does not require `scenarios` (the technical scenarios of the `scripted_fixture` Mode), `answer_schema` (read only by the scripted fixture) or a Partition under `cases` (read by the entry points that need that Partition): each of those entry points refuses the key's absence, with a code, in Track code. The rule that a Configuration may extend only a declared Configuration, without a cycle, relates values to each other and stays in Track code (hypotrail.agentic.declaration).

cases.description: The file of the Cases of each Partition role. The roles are the Track's (hypotrail.agentic.partitions); a Workload cannot add one.

configuration.description: Either a full system text, or another Configuration's text followed by one added instruction.
